svg.aria-label: FIG. 2. Who can move what in one lane. The lane holds the USDG and stock tokens it tracks. The owner funds it once through openLane and is the only account it pays outside swaps: close and, after closing, rescue; the owner can also set the identity URI. The agent can only seal and trade, and no token moves to it. Tokens otherwise move only in swaps with the Uniswap v4 PoolManager. The feed and the factory's asset and pool lists are read, live. The factory owner can only call the factory: list assets and pools, set the burn amount and identity base, set the token once.
svg.title: FIG. 2 who moves what
